data.narrative:
Open Cosmos is a Growth-stage space and aerospace company founded by Rafel Jorda Siquier, Jordi Barrera Ars, and Aleix Megias Homar that has raised $50M to date. The valuation universe includes 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) trading at a median P/S of 24.4x, and 8 private-sector peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, Sierra Space, and Planet Labs.

Given data constraints, only one quantitative method proved applicable. Stage-Progression analysis, using the $50M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 1.2x multiplier typical of Growth-stage advancement, yields $60M. Peer-Median triangulation could not be applied due to insufficient comparable datapoints within the same stage and valuation tier in Space & Aerospace—while 14 same-sector peers exist, none of the adjacent-stage or similar-tier filters produced three or more usable comparables. Public-Comp Anchoring using the 24.4x P/S median was inapplicable absent revenue disclosure from the target.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $51M to $69M, centered on $60M, derived primarily from stage-progression methodology. Key uncertainties include the absence of direct peer revenue multiples applicable to Open Cosmos's specific business model and commercial maturity. Additional revenue and margin data would enable more robust public-comparable anchoring and narrow the current range materially.
